[[File:Aila.png|thumb|250px|Aila]] [[File:Aila statue.png|thumb|left|250px|Aila as a statue]] '''Aila''' (Japanese: '''アイラ''' ''Aira'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XYS05|The Legend of X, Y, and Z!]]''. She is the daughter of a village elder and the love interest of {{OBP|Jan|XYS05}}. ==History== Aila first appeared when she was talking to Jan, unsuccessfully warning him not to pursue {{p|Yveltal}} at her father's behest. After their conversation, Jan rode off on his {{p|Gogoat}}. Soon after, Yveltal showed up and threatened to attack her. Noticing this, Jan turned back and commanded his {{p|Talonflame}} to attack it. After Yveltal turned Talonflame into stone with {{m|Oblivion Wing}}, Yveltal fired another Oblivion Wing at Jan. Aila jumped in front of him, however, and took the attack herself. This caused her to turn into stone as well. Jan would later put her petrified body in a cave to keep her safe, and it would stay there for many years until {{an|Professor Sycamore}} and [[Alexa]] discovered and examined her in the present day. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{dark color}}|bordercolor={{fairy color light}} |ja=赤崎千夏 ''[[Chinatsu Akasaki]]'' |en=[[Haven Paschall]] |fi=Amy Burgess |it=Ludovica De Caro |th=ธันยนันท์ พิพัฒน์ไชยศิริ ''Thanyanan Piphatchaisiri'' |es_eu=Sara Polo |vi=Nguyễn Thụy Thùy Tiên}}
